summary: Comprehensive audit and architectural overhaul plan for the Project & Milestone category to achieve 100% fidelity with the official 13-page NCH Market Activator presentation. Identifies every missing role feature, audits the 7-step end-to-end data flow (Cahier des charges -> KV Créa -> Client validation -> CDP Commander -> Créa Production -> Terrain & Pointage -> Direction validation -> Compta CCP SFP 01), aligns sidebar navigation to exact slide terminology, and automates indirect stock traceability from field purchase declarations.
